entries.title: Security Force Targeting
entries.description: Insults, threats, or incitement aimed at police, military, or state institutions.
supporting_evidence: A class-wide hostile statement targets a state body.
The sentence encourages opposition or harm.
contradictory_evidence: The line is a neutral report.
The speaker is quoting an officer in testimony.
false_positives: An audit report about institutional weakness.
counter_examples: A news segment on police reform.
cross_sentence_indicators: A mild complaint becomes a hostile class-wide attack.
reviewer_guidance: Distinguish one-off criticism from class-based hostility.
Look for direct hostility toward institutions.

confidence_modifiers.title: Collective Attack
confidence_modifiers.description: Hostility aimed at the institution as a class.

confidence_modifiers.title: Individual Complaint
confidence_modifiers.description: A complaint about a single officer only.

glossary_relationships.note: Police are part of state institutions.

gcam_mappings.note: Use when state institutions are attacked or discredited.
